personas.name: The Comparison Shopper
personas.description: Recently engaged couples actively evaluating wedding website platforms. They're comparing Say I Do against The Knot, Zola, WithJoy, and others — reading reviews, checking feature lists, and researching pricing tiers to find the best fit.

personas.name: The Digital Invites Planner
personas.description: Couples focused on the invitations and save-the-dates side of wedding planning. They're exploring digital vs. print options, looking for design inspiration, and figuring out etiquette around online invitations. Say I Do's digital invitation features are their entry point.

personas.name: The First-Time Planner
personas.description: Overwhelmed couples early in their wedding planning journey who need guidance and how-tos. They're searching for tips, checklists, and best practices — often not yet committed to a platform but looking for one that can walk them through the process.

personas.name: The Guest Experience Optimizer
personas.description: Couples who are past the big-picture planning and now focused on the guest-facing details — managing RSVPs, tracking dietary requirements, organizing seating, and making it easy for guests to share photos. They value tools that make the experience seamless for everyone.

personas.name: The Non-Traditional Couple
personas.description: Couples who aren't following the conventional wedding playbook. They're exploring alternatives to traditional ceremonies, elopements, or unconventional formats — and are drawn to platforms flexible enough to support their vision without imposing a cookie-cutter template.
